story.title: The Memory Mirror
story.logline: A woman discovers her mirror reflection acts three seconds ahead of her, trying to warn her of a fatal mistake.
story.theme: The illusion of control over our own final moments.
story.twist: She realizes she is not the living person, but the reflection trying to break through the glass.
story.ending: Who is trapped on the other side of your glass right now?

scenes.narration: My reflection just blinked three full seconds before I did, shattering every law of nature in my quiet bathroom.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16. Clara, a 28-year-old woman with messy dark hair and a faded gray hoodie, stares wide-eyed at a vintage bathroom mirror.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on Clara's startled eyes, rack focus to the mirror.

scenes.narration: I froze, watching her raise a trembling hand to press flat against the cold glass surface ahead of me.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 28, dark hair, gray hoodie, inside a dimly lit tiled bathroom, staring in horror at the mirror.
scenes.camera: Medium shot from behind Clara, showing her back and her reflection already moving.

scenes.narration: My own hand lifted a second later to match hers, but her fingers were already tracing desperate words backward.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 28, dark hair, gray hoodie, in the bathroom, pressing her palm against the misty glass.
scenes.camera: Close-up on the glass interface where breath fog reveals frantic backward writing.

scenes.narration: The letters spelled out a warning I refused to read: 'Step back, she is coming behind you.'
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 28, dark hair, gray hoodie, in the bathroom, reading the backward text on the mirror.
scenes.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot focusing on the backward words forming on the glass.

scenes.narration: A sudden shadow fell across the bathroom doorway, blocking the harsh hallway light and freezing my breath.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 28, dark hair, gray hoodie, turning her head rapidly toward the dark doorway of the bathroom.
scenes.camera: Wide angle from inside the bathroom, framing the dark hallway threshold.

scenes.narration: I spun around to face the intruder, but the hallway was completely empty, silent, and bitterly cold.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 28, dark hair, gray hoodie, spinning around in the narrow, empty apartment hallway.
scenes.camera: Tracking shot following her frantic spin into the empty corridor.

scenes.narration: When I looked back at the mirror, my reflection was smiling with a terrifying, absolute sense of relief.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 28, dark hair, gray hoodie, looking back into the bathroom mirror with sudden dread.
scenes.camera: Medium shot facing Clara as she looks into the glass.

scenes.narration: She slammed her fist through the glass, and jagged shards exploded outward into my empty hallway.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara's reflection, 28, dark hair, gray hoodie, violently punching outward from inside the mirror.
scenes.camera: Dynamic low angle capturing the glass shattering directly toward the lens.

scenes.narration: Suddenly, I was the one standing inside the cold frame, watching her bleed on the real floor.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 28, dark hair, gray hoodie, now trapped inside the vintage mirror frame, looking out.
scenes.camera: POV shot looking through the broken mirror frame at the bathroom floor.

scenes.narration: She touched the glass from the outside, crying as she realized too late who was trapped inside.
scenes.visual_prompt: Clara, 28, dark hair, gray hoodie, touching the glass surface from the outside world.
scenes.camera: Close-up on the two hands pressing against the glass divider from opposite sides.

caption.hook: Three seconds ahead of life and death.
caption.title: The Memory Mirror
caption.caption:
She thought the glass was warning her about a fatal mistake. But as the shattering truth sets in, she realizes she isn't the one holding the breath.

Who is trapped on the wrong side of reality?
